Election day volunteers are typically from all different parts of the community, and this year a physician and a farm worker were interviewed about their experiences as poll workers. The physician talked about how important elections are, but admitted to having mostly avoided doing any actual work this year and mostly just sat around all day. The farm worker, on the other hand, was exhausted after a long and busy day of helping people to vote. Who was very hard-working?
A. The physician
B. The farm worker
C. Not answerable
